facts: P16 shutter illumination derives open aperture from actual replicated casement GlobalTransform and original window tangent, retaining only thresholded change and per-aperture contribution history. It reconstructs lighting from base_samples after any aperture change; source lighting is independent from retained render samples. Comparing worldtransformed axis to scene-frame tangent requires actual roottransform identity/rotation contract before a mixed-frame defect is promoted.

P16 recipe_mesh projects original native position minus suppliedlocalorigin once; normals/UVs/indices share immutable batch, tangent generation is explicit material capability policy. Material enum support versus actual map use remains separate generation capability, not all classes necessarily normal mapped.

P16 casement OnAdd selects primary material via the enum-owned WindowLeafKind::material and spawns remaining material batches as children of the same leaf; body andhardware followsame replicated transform. This is one closure realization, not separate scalar-angle rendering authority. Supported replacement lifecycle still conditional.

P16 strategic building instances obtains one generated building datum and uses it for door/window pose conversion and geometry; actual descriptors and transforms are inserted from the same leaf. PreparedBuildingGeometry plan/collision are retained with SceneBuilding descriptor to avoid independent regeneration. Arbitrary SceneBuilding replacement may need lifecycle proof, prior actual cached-view findings remain.
